title: Multi-Timeframe Analytical Predictor
description: Combine technical indicators into a multi-timeframe forecasting model that generates directional predictions (BULLISH, BEARISH, NEUTRAL), confidence scores (0-100%), and human-readable analytical reasons.
acceptanceCriteria: Predictor outputs directional state, confidence score, and formatted reason strings for 1m, 5m, and 15m
Unit tests validate rule combinations for bullish and bearish states
